description: Gear up for game-changing experiences with the PNY NVIDIA GeForce RTX™ 5070 Ti and AI-powered DLSS 5. Built with NVIDIA Blackwell and equipped with blistering-fast GDDR7 memory, it lets you run the most graphically demanding games and creative applications with stunning fidelity and performance. With NVIDIA Studio you can bring your creative projects to life faster than ever. Designed to sustain extreme performance, PNY’s triple-fan cooling system features three refined 90mm axial fans engineered for increased airflow, reduced turbulence, and long-lasting durability with dual ball bearings. Stealth Mode automatically stops the fans at low temperatures for near-silent operation, while an advanced vapor chamber and ultra-dense heatsink rapidly pull heat away from the GPU. An open aluminum backplate enhances airflow and reinforces structural stability for consistent performance under heavy loads. This factory-overclocked edition boosts to 2572 MHz out of the box. With VelocityX™ software, you gain full control over performance tuning, fan behavior, and monitoring, all from one intuitive interface. Powered by NVIDIA DLSS 5 and fourth-generation Ray Tracing cores, the RTX 5070 Ti delivers exceptional visual fidelity, blistering frame rates, and a true creative AI advantage for gaming, streaming, and professional workflows.

Military-Grade Components ​ 
TUF Chokes & MOSFETs: Certified military-grade TUF chokes and MOSFETs deliver rock-solid power to the GPU, which can help improve system stability.​

A premium phase-change GPU thermal pad melts to fill gaps, ensuring superior heat dissipation. 
Protective PCB Coating 
Conformal coating protects circuit boards from short-circuits due to moisture, dust, or debris.​ 
Dual-ball Fan Bearings​ 
Dual-ball bearings excel at durability and can last up to twice as long as sleeve bearing designs.​​

Cooling Mastery 
ASUS MaxContact, phase-change thermal pad and Axial-tech fans ensure advanced cooling performance. 
MaxContact Design​ 
MaxContact expands the heat spreader surface area by 5%, improving GPU temperatures by up to 2°C.​ 
Axial-tech Upgrades 
Axial-tech fans spin on dual-ball bearings and propel up to 31% more air than standard fans. 
0dB Technology 
Fans stop below 50°C, allowing quieter operation during light tasks or less demanding games. 
Vented Exoskeleton​ 
A diecast shroud and aluminum backplate feature large vents for better heat dissipation.​
